answer: For a jade relic appraisal market, allocate subsidies by conserved flow from a fixed set of audited trust roots. Each root releases ten credits per epoch; endorsements split that budget, never copy it. A whisper of referrals among 1,000 fake accounts cannot increase the credits crossing into their cluster. To capture more, an attacker must bribe independent roots to surrender scarce budgets. This limits subsidy farming only if root membership is controlled and roots cannot mint extra flow.
